description:
The Engineering Manager needs a real-time view of the team's bug workload to identify bottlenecks. Your task is to:

1. Create a **Shared Query** named **'Open Bugs Snapshot'** that filters for all **Bugs** that are **not Closed** or **Removed** (i.e., New, Active, Committed).
2. Create a **Pie Chart** widget on the **'TailwindTraders Team'** dashboard using this query.
3. Configure the chart to Group By **'Assigned To'** so the manager can see who is overloaded.

Start by opening Microsoft Edge and navigating to the TailwindTraders project.
